noticias.titular: Jays' Max Scherzer waits to decide on returning for 20th season
noticias.texto: Blue Jays right-hander Max Scherzer said Saturday he will wait until the offseason to decide whether he wants to play a 20th major league season in 2027.

noticias.titular: Marlins' Perez one-hits Braves in MLB's 11th shutout of season
noticias.texto: Eury Perez dominated the playoff-bound Braves, finishing with a one-hit shutout Friday night in the Marlins' 3-0 win.
